buildings.description: BCM Zodiac is a landmark hybrid commercial development by BCM Group located in Nipania, Indore. Spread across approximately 10 lakh sq ft, the project integrates premium retail spaces, showrooms, food courts, entertainment zones, and high-end corporate office spaces within a single ecosystem. Featuring 50,000 sq ft office floor plates, 3.5 lakh sq ft of parking, a 6-screen multiplex, hypermarket, and premium lifestyle amenities, BCM Zodiac is positioned as one of Indore's most ambitious commercial destinations for businesses and investors.

buildings.description: NKS Complex is an upcoming commercial development in Indore's Bhagirath Pura–Sukhliya corridor, offering retail and commercial business opportunities in a well-connected urban market. Positioned in a high-demand residential and commercial zone, the project is suitable for shops, service businesses, and office users seeking accessibility, visibility, and long-term commercial growth.
